show.description:
Garima Kaul’s impulsive marriage to a stranger turns her world upside down when she realizes her husband Neeraj is actually Aryan Scindia — her cold, powerful boss.
"The Second First Marriage" follows Garima and Aryan’s tangled journey of secrets, love, and second chances.
